format: JSONL: id, case_type, reference_date, text, expected TravelRequestDraft, expected_status; optional annotation
status_policy: expected_status is reviewed label ready, needs_clarification, or invalid; validation code is not a substitute for semantic review
limitations: Synthetic cases are not representative of real traveler traffic.
Annotations are hand-authored fixtures and should receive domain review before being used for model selection.
Exact match is intentionally strict; a valid Pydantic response may still be semantically wrong.
